name: local-llm
about: Run open-weight LLMs on NVIDIA CUDA, discrete AMD Radeon Vulkan, Apple GPUs through a libkrun Podman machine, or the CPU. Vulkan uses llama.cpp; NVIDIA also offers ik_llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, TabbyAPI and LM Studio for internal use only. Weights download only on Run.
description: Runs open-source LLMs on this workspace's hardware. NVIDIA GPUs keep CUDA and DGX Spark uses unified memory. Discrete AMD Radeon GPUs use Vulkan RADV; AMD support is unit-tested and unverified on hardware. Apple GPUs use Vulkan Venus through a separate libkrun Podman machine with a provisional memory cap and unknown host headroom. Vulkan profiles offer only llama.cpp's Vulkan build. Hosts with no usable GPU run on the CPU automatically. vLLM on DGX Spark is experimental and requires ploinky var LOCAL_LLM_VLLM_UNIFIED experimental. LM Studio is proprietary, for internal use only, and requires ploinky var LOCAL_LLM_LMSTUDIO internal-use and acceptance of its Terms. Administrators choose a model and runner in Settings; weights download only when Run is pressed. The manifest declares containerSecurity.gpu; ploinky gpu revoke --agent local-llms/local-llm takes GPU access away and ploinky gpu grant --agent local-llms/local-llm restores it.

capabilities.summary: Serves the open-weight model an administrator runs on this workspace's GPU or CPU.
capabilities.whenToUse: Call soul_gateway/local-llms/local-llm/default for private, on-machine generation once a model is ready; it answers 503 not_ready otherwise.
